facts.text: Proposal: new sliding gate across the vehicular access onto Mill Road, a classified road with a thirty miles per hour limit.
Gate set back 5.2 m from the carriageway edge; gate slides parallel to the boundary and does not open over the highway.
Gate in powder-coated steel, matching the existing boundary railings in height and finish.
Highway authority letter dated 10 February 2026 confirms in writing that a visibility splay is not required for this access.

retrieved_policies.heading: Policy G4 Gates and boundaries
retrieved_policies.text: A gate across an access onto a classified road shall be set back at least 5.0 m from the carriageway edge and shall open inward. Visibility splays shall be provided in accordance with Table 2 of the Design SPD unless the highway authority confirms in writing that a splay is not required for the access.

reasons.finding: The gate is set back 5.2 m (site-plan-E) and the highway authority has confirmed in writing that no splay is required (statement-3), which is the G4 exception and Table 2 Note 1; the Table 2 splay is therefore not imposed.

conditions.text: The gate shall be retained set back at least 5.0 m from the carriageway edge and shall not open outward over the highway.
